evidence.observation: System pressure dropped from ~500 to ~255 mbar over k=10-13, then recovered and settled at ~300 mbar, a new setpoint far from the original
Transient spike to 18.6 mbar at k=10 then settled slightly negative (-0.4 to 0.0), unlike the stable +0.6 before
Reboiler temperature excursion 443 -> 323 -> 426 °C tracking the pressure change
Overhead temperatures fell ~11 °C and only partly recovered (63.3 -> 52.5), consistent with the lower operating pressure

args.missing_evidence: Whether the pressure change to ~300 mbar was a commanded setpoint change (protocol/controller log) or an uncontrolled leak/vacuum-control fault; also a distillate composition measurement.
